summary: Identity, authorization and application spine: custom User + cookie-backed Session auth with deterministic seeded acceptance identities, a scoped many-to-many Workspace/Membership role model, a central authz decision function with DRF permission classes enforcing backend role isolation, PublicIdModel + Idempotency-Key mutation dedupe, and an AuditEvent + transactional DomainEvent outbox foundation.

task_notes.ID-001: workspaces.Role (TextChoices) + workspaces.Membership(user, workspace, role) with a unique_together constraint; multiple roles per user/workspace are supported (e.g. organizer+judge) rather than one role column.
task_notes.ID-002: accounts.Session (DB-backed opaque cookie token, not contrib.sessions) backs both interactive login (accounts/login/, password-checked) and out-of-band seeded acceptance identities (management command `seed_acceptance_identities`, unusable passwords, fixed tokens) through the same table/cookie mechanism.
task_notes.ID-003: core/authz.py (roles_for/has_any_role) + core/permissions.py (IsWorkspaceMember, HasWorkspaceRole/require_roles) enforced on workspaces.WorkspaceMembersView and audit.WorkspaceAuditLogView; denial returns 401/403, never a silent empty/filtered 200.
task_notes.ID-004: core.models.PublicIdModel (UUID public_id on every domain model) and core.models.IdempotencyKey + core.idempotency.IdempotentMixin (Idempotency-Key header dedupe, reused-key-different-body rejected with 422), applied to workspace creation.
task_notes.ID-005: audit.AuditEvent (evidence) + audit.DomainEvent (pending outbox row) written together via audit.services.record_mutation, which asserts it is called inside the caller's transaction.atomic() block so evidence/intent commit or roll back with the mutation.
task_notes.ID-006: tests/integration/test_identity_authz.py (15 tests): session auth (valid/missing/unknown cookie), login success/failure, multi-role membership, backend-enforced isolation (organizer-only member/audit listing denies judge/participant/outsider/anonymous), idempotent replay + conflicting-body rejection, and seeded-identity idempotency/role/isolation.
